title: Frontend: reflect corrected createdAt for “Backroads Litter” after backend migration

requirements.summary: Ensure Home feed and Post Detail pages display the corrected Australia/Sydney date for the “Backroads Litter” post once the backend stored createdAt value is migrated, without changing existing date formatting behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the date shown for "Backroads Litter" renders as "8 January 2026" (Australia/Sydney) using the existing date formatting utility.
On the Post Detail page for "Backroads Litter", the date shown renders as "8 January 2026" (Australia/Sydney) using the existing date formatting utility.
No changes are made that alter date formatting for other posts beyond reflecting the corrected stored timestamp.

file_operations.description: Adjust post-fetching React Query behavior (for getAllPosts/getPost) to reliably refetch after a backend deploy/upgrade so the UI picks up the corrected persisted createdAt timestamp without altering the existing Australia/Sydney date formatter.
